summary: Completed frontend testing of breadcrumb navigation feature in NoteEditor. All 11 feature scenarios from the review request passed successfully. Tested note hierarchy breadcrumbs (Root > Child > Grandchild), folder-based breadcrumbs (Work > Project > Tasks), clickable ancestor navigation, hiding breadcrumbs on root-level notes, folder-only breadcrumbs when no parent note, ellipsis menu coexistence, and sidebar toggle behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: NoteEditor.jsx breadcrumb logic has dead code at lines 173-175: 'rootNote' and 'actualRoot' variables are equivalent since ancestors[0] is always a note from allNotes; the re-lookup is redundant. Minor cleanup opportunity but not a bug.
Folder chain walking duplicated between the 'parent note exists' branch and 'folder only' branch (lines 180-189 vs 196-205). Could be extracted into a small helper for DRY compliance.
breadcrumb-nav chain does not truncate or collapse for very deep hierarchies - may wrap to multiple lines (flex-wrap is set, which is acceptable), but no max-depth ellipsis. Acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Created localStorage-only test data: Root Page, Child Page, Grandchild Page, Work folder, Project note, Tasks sub-page. Persisted in browser localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Breadcrumb feature fully working. Selectors: breadcrumb-nav (container), breadcrumb-{noteId} (clickable ancestor note buttons), breadcrumb-folder-{folderId} (folder labels). Current note is shown as bold plain text (no testid). localStorage must be cleared at test start via page.evaluate('localStorage.clear()') + reload to avoid cross-test contamination.
